title: Transfers
subtitle: Move students between Temari schools — request, approve, print the letter.
noBranch: Select a branch to manage transfers.

search.title: Find the student
search.hint: Ask the family for the student ID from their current school (it is on the report card and the Temari app).
search.notFound: No enrolled student matches that ID.
search.sameBranch: This student is already enrolled at your branch.

form.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Family moved to the area
form.sent: Request sent to the current school.
form.documentsHint: Report card, fee-clearance slip, parent's letter… up to 5 files (PDF or images).

approveDesc: {student} will leave your school: their enrollment closes here and opens at {school}. Confirm any outstanding fees are settled first — this cannot be undone.
rejectDesc: Tell the requesting school why (e.g. outstanding fee balance).
cancelDesc: The request will be cancelled. You can send a new one later.
emptyDesc: When another Temari school requests one of your students — or you request theirs — it appears here.

letter.title: Student transfer letter
letter.footer: Generated by Temari.et — verifiable against reference {ref}.
letter.scanToVerify: Scan to verify this letter online
letter.verified: Verified — this letter matches Temari's records.
letter.notFound: This letter could not be verified. Check the link or contact the issuing school.

withdrawal.title: Withdraw student
withdrawal.desc: {name} leaves the school. The enrollment closes and a printable clearance letter is issued. Records are kept — nothing is deleted.
withdrawal.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Family relocating, moving to a school outside Temari…
withdrawal.outstandingWarning: Outstanding balance: {amount} ETB. Withdrawal is not blocked — the amount is noted on the clearance letter.
withdrawal.outstandingNote: Outstanding balance at withdrawal: {amount} ETB — recorded by the school; this letter remains valid.

detail.title: Transfer request
detail.noOpenInvoices: No open invoices — the student is fee-clear.
detail.outstandingWarning: {count} open invoice(s) · {amount} ETB outstanding. Approving hands the student over anyway — settle or note the balance first.

family.title: Transfers
family.subtitle: Track your children's school transfers and request one online
family.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you requesting this transfer?
family.unpaidWarning: This student has {count} unpaid invoice(s). The current school reviews outstanding fees before approving a transfer.
family.howItWorks: How it works: your application goes to the school you chose. If they accept, the request is sent to the current school for final approval. You will be notified at every step.
family.submitted: Application submitted. You will be notified when the school responds.
family.emptyDesc: School moves for your children will appear here — you can also request one online.

progress.submitted: Waiting for the destination school to respond.
progress.awaitingCurrent: Accepted — now awaiting approval from the current school.
progress.rejected: The current school rejected the request.
progress.declined: The destination school declined the application.

applications.empty: No online applications yet. Families can apply from their Temari.et portal.
applications.accepted: Application accepted — the request now awaits the current school.
applications.acceptDesc: Place {student} (currently at {school}) into a year and grade. The current school still gives the final approval.
applications.declineDesc: The family will see your note.
applications.declinePlaceholder: e.g. No seats available in that grade this year.

bulk.approveDesc: Each student is handed over to the receiving school — approval is your fee-clearance signal. This cannot be undone.
bulk.rejectDesc: The students stay with you. The receiving school is told, so say why below.
bulk.noneActionable: Nothing to decide — only pending requests for students you are sending can be decided here.
